description:
Job description

Sobre a AlmapBBDO

QUEM SOMOS!

#1 Agência Global da Década - Cannes Lions.

Somos uma potência de criatividade e negócios que se reinventa todos os dias.

Acreditamos que a criatividade é protagonista na geração de valor para as marcas, no crescimento dos negócios dos clientes e, não menos importante, na transformação das pessoas. Porque as pessoas são o centro da cultura da agência.

Aqui na AlmapBBDO estimulamos um ambiente cada vez mais plural que permita trocas e aprendizados. Convidamos pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, com deficiência, mulheres e vindas de diferentes níveis socioeconômicos, regiões e universidades do país a fazer parte do nosso time.

Este é o nosso horizonte definitivo, visto por todas as equipes de nossa agência. E é assim que construímos, dia após dia, um ambiente diverso e uma grande ideia chamada AlmapBBDO.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!


Main responsibilities

  • Gestão de entregas de mídia no digital e offline
  • Gestão de entregas de produção audiovisual
  • Desenvolver briefings e atas de reunião
  • Transitar entre as áreas da agência e integrá-las, assim como ser interlocutor(a) direto do cliente.
  • Manter o cronograma dos trabalhos em dia
  • Acompanhar faturamento com estagiários

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência em atendimento publicitário
  • Experiência com campanhas digitais e offline
  • Skill de negociação com cliente e deptos internos: entenda de prazos, fornecedores e consiga ser uma interlocução com propriedade entre ambos os lados
  • Necessário inglês ou espanhol
  • Desejável ter experiência com conta de grande porte e grande volume de entregas

Additional information

  • Modelo híbrido (2x-3x presencial na agência em dias determinados, restante em home office)

title: Assistente de Logística - Vaga Afirmativa Para PCD
description:
Conheça sua missão:

  1. Realiza o monitoramento das entregas por meio do painel de controle de separação e do sistema SAP, assegurando a alocação correta de pedidos para cada separador, faz a tratativa das remessa com furos de estoque, pendências de geração de ordens de transporte (OT) e trocas de lotes;
  2. Garante que todos os pedidos sejam separados dentro dos prazos estipulados, validando-os no sistema para a posterior emissão da nota fiscal. Possui conhecimento em roteirização, monitora o processo de carregamento e verifica que todos os pedidos programados para o dia estejam prontos e a caminho do cliente;
  3. Acompanha as demandas registradas pelo Centro de Serviço ao Cliente (CSN), incluindo reposições e coletas solicitadas. Está ciente dos relatórios e indicadores da área, embora possa necessitar de orientação adicional para uma compreensão mais aprofundada;
  4. Direcionar os colaboradores encarregados das separações utilizando o painel de controle de separação e o sistema SAP, garantindo que sejam concluídas dentro do prazo estipulado para entrega;
  5. Realiza a gestão dos casos de furo de estoque e o diagnóstico das questões por meio do dashboard, propondo medidas de aprimoramento na área de atuação. Conduz todos os procedimentos internos pertinentes às devoluções;
  6. Demonstra autonomia e tem habilidade no processo de distribuição de pedidos e assume a responsabilidade pela organização do pátio, orientando a equipe quando necessário;
  7. Assegura tanto a produtividade quanto a satisfação dos clientes no que tange ao processo de retirada de mercadorias, e mantém um controle rigoroso dos pedidos relacionados à expedição e retirada, garantindo que sejam entregues dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  8. Realiza a interpretação de dados do dashboard, sendo capaz de se adaptar a situações complexas e aprimorar processos existentes de maneira eficaz. Conduz de forma autônoma as situações de furo de estoque, colaborando diretamente com o gestor para resolvê-las;
  9. Participa das reuniões de briefing, identificando na logística áreas que requerem melhorias, propondo ideias para aumentar a eficiência dos separadores, e fornece orientação e direcionamento a equipe de forma eficiente;
  10. Realiza acompanhamentos de furos de estoque e inventários rotativos, produz relatórios de inventários, contribuindo de maneira significativa para a compreensão e superação dos desafios relacionados à redução de demarca;
  11. Executa a gestão de estoque, validando as faltas de estoque e quaisquer discrepâncias identificadas, monitorando de perto o indicador de demarca, promovendo e realizando os ajustes quando necessário;
  12. Atua como multiplicador no processo de gestão de estoque dentro da sua unidade, assumindo a responsabilidade de ser o zelador de todos os procedimentos relacionados a gestão de estoque, e apoia ativamente a área de Supply no desenvolvimento de relatórios relacionados à gestão de estoque;
  13. Garantir a execução dos inventários, tanto sistêmicos quanto físicos evitando erros de contagens e ajustes;
  14. Notifica a equipe de cadastro sempre que há a necessidade de atualizar informações cadastrais dos materiais, identificadas durante o processo de conferência, contribuindo para a conclusão tranquila do processo de recebimento, sem contratempos;
  15. Executa a liberação de canhotos de todas as notas recebidas, certificando que os processos foram concluídas com sucesso. Certifica-se de que todas as notas recebidas foram processadas com sucesso ao término do expediente. Realiza o arquivamento de documentos fiscais de maneira eficiente e organizada;
  16. Notifica os fornecedores que não cumpriram com as normas internas de segurança e procedimentos estabelecidos;
  17. Colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelando pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, mantendo atualizada a planilha de controles de pallets e resíduos, e realizando as auditorias dos mesmos;
  18. Manter atualizado os lançamentos de FreteFob e fornecer total suporte para solucionar pendencias de pagamentos;
  19. Realizar o controle do depósito de recebimento, assegurando a atualização constante e evitando a estagnação de produtos por mais de 24 horas;
  20. Efetua o controle de notas de devoluções aos fornecedores e mantém a comunicação ativa para soluções de abatimento, realiza a criação de DTs de forma correta evitando que NFs fiquem sem lançamentos, e executa o processo de estorno fazendo o acompanhamentos até a etapa final do processo;
  21. Apoia no controle dos insumos da seção.

Para fazer parte do nosso time você deve ter:

  1. Superior completo em Administração, Logística ou correlatas;
  2. Conhecimento em logística, produto e em sistemas de gerenciamento de armazém.

Pacote de Benefícios:

  1. Assistência médica;
  2. Assistência odontológica;
  3. Seguro de vida;
  4. Gympass;
  5. Refeição no local;
  6. Cesta básica;
  7. Cesta de Natal;
  8. Prêmio de Progresso;
  9. Licença-maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  10. Vale transporte ou estacionamento.

title: Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience
description:
Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally to ensure our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We recognize our responsibility and need for change, understanding that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from volunteers from different businesses and actively participate in defining our DE&I strategies. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.
For millions of customers worldwide, the Amazon name is synonymous with delivery – and the Delivery Experience (DEX) team provides those customers with innovative ways to get what they want and need, enabling the choices they make on every order, every day. We combine customer impact with retail invention, solving huge technical challenges along the way.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast-growing business for Amazon.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Delivery Experience Regionalization. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-impact processes and supporting teams that help us deliver on our customer promise seamlessly. This role will partner closely with Amazon Transportation, Operations, Finance, Retail, and WW DEX leadership to solve customer-facing shipping solutions.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Define and deliver important programs with broad cross-functional and cross-organizational business impact.
  2. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of a highly complicated cross-functional project in a new business area.
  3. Delivery strategy: work closely with team leadership to define priorities for delivery strategy internally and with partners, using data to create and communicate business plans to senior leadership.
  4. Product Definition: incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class customer experience.
  5. Support and own the design and development of projects, working through all related dependencies with internal and external teams, mainly Operations, Transportation, Buyer Risk Prevention, and Technology teams.
  6. Develop customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and business requirements, participating in the design of the user experience, release goals, and prioritization of assigned features according to customer value.
  7. Bring strong, data-driven business and strategic judgment to decisions.
  8. Develop business and process requirements, prioritize needs, and manage milestones and overall roadmap.
  9. Enhance Amazon delivery experience, including the definition of shipping prices and shipping promotions.
  10. Bring analytical horsepower, enhanced Excel skills (and ideally SQL), and a deep curiosity about how things work.
  11. Identify and develop opportunities for improved cash flow in Shipping Programs.
  12. Engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy, and outlook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Relevant years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, or technology experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery.
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
- Experience as a product manager or owner.
- Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Senior Developer – Celergo Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking to join a dynamic, inclusive team environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

As a Senior Developer, you are an innovative thinker with a "can-do" attitude. You will work with teams across the company to leverage technologies that support our backend applications. Your work can include new features, enhancements, and resolving defects for frontend and backend solutions. Those things are important because our products impact people's lives.

Every day, you'll be coding and asking questions that clarify scalability and user challenges. You will be part of an Agile environment working with a team of talented engineers, product owners, and stakeholders continually developing, deploying, and testing application software.

To be successful in this role, you must know how to create functional, maintainable, and scalable code in an object-oriented fashion. You have real-world experience solving business problems and thrive in a fast-paced, Agile environment where you can quickly change direction when needed. You are happy to do hands-on coding and development in .NET alongside a team of coders. Your experience allows you to act as a mentor to junior developers. Our best leaders are great communicators and passionate creators who stay current on the latest technologies. They're always looking for new ways to provide more business value and return on investment while growing their careers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.
  • You have strong experience in relevant skills gained and developed in the same or similar role.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • You'll have a Bachelor's degree OR equivalent.
  • Prior experience that would give you extra comfort in the role includes:
  • .NET Framework - .NET Core
  • C#
  • SQL Server
  • Unit testing
  • EF Core / ORM Frameworks
  • Git
  • Web API development and REST API
  • Microservices
  • TypeScript
  • React.Js
  • Stencil

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Have courageous team collaboration. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and challenge one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Orchestration
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer – Cloud Orchestration role at Nokia

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer – Cloud Orchestration to lead the design and development of highly scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures for our mining technology solutions. This role is key to ensuring orchestration, automation, and optimization of our cloud-based AI, IoT, and data processing workloads.

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Architect and develop cloud-native orchestration frameworks for managing large-scale AI, IoT, and industrial applications.
  • Design and implement Kubernetes-based infrastructure with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) for scalability and security.
  • Lead the integration of edge computing and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) to enable real-time data processing and decision-making.
  • Develop high-performance microservices architectures using event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) strategies with Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi.
  • Ensure high availability and disaster recovery for mission-critical mining applications.
  • Optimize resource allocation and cost efficiency using AI-driven cloud orchestration techniques.
  • Work closely with AI, networking, and data engineering teams to ensure seamless deployment and scalability.
  • Define best practices for security, compliance, and observability (IAM, Zero Trust, SRE principles).
  • Drive CI/CD automation, improving deployment cycles and system reliability.

Key Skills And Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud software engineering, distributed systems, and cloud orchestration.
  • Expertise in Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and container orchestration in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  • Strong programming experience in Golang, Python, or Rust for cloud-native development.
  • Deep knowledge of serverless computing (Lambda, Knative), service mesh (Istio, Consul), and edge computing frameworks.
  • Experience with real-time streaming data processing frameworks (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or TensorFlow Serving).
  • Familiarity with 5G, TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking), and IoT networking protocols.
  • Proven experience in multi-cloud security, authentication (OAuth, JWT, OpenID Connect), and compliance (ISO 27001, IEC 62443).
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps and SRE principles, including CI/CD pipelines (GitOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in industrial automation, mining, or telecom environments.
  • Knowledge of AI model deployment, optimization, and inference at scale.
  • Experience with hybrid cloud and edge computing strategies.
  • Understanding of decentralized orchestration frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to tackle complex distributed systems challenges.
  • Effective collaboration across AI, networking, DevOps, and product teams.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to mentor junior engineers.

About Us

Come create the technology that helps the world act together

Nokia is committed to innovation and technology leadership across mobile, fixed and cloud networks. Your career here will have a positive impact on people’s lives and will help us build the capabilities needed for a more productive, sustainable, and inclusive world.

We challenge ourselves to create an inclusive way of working where we are open to new ideas, empowered to take risks and fearless to bring our authentic selves to work.

What we offer

Nokia offers continuous learning opportunities, well-being programs to support you mentally and physically, opportunities to join and get supported by employee resource groups, mentoring programs and highly diverse teams with an inclusive culture where people thrive and are empowered.

Nokia is committed to inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer

Nokia has received the following recognitions for its commitment to inclusion & equality:

  • One of the World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere
  • Gender-Equality Index by Bloomberg
  • Workplace Pride Global Benchmark

At Nokia, we act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Nokia’s employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.

Join us and be part of a company where you will feel included and empowered to succeed.

About The Team

Strategy and Technology lays the path for Nokia’s future technology innovation and identifies the most promising areas for Nokia to create new value. We set the company’s strategy and technology vision, offer an unparalleled research foundation for innovation, and provide critical support infrastructure for Nokia.

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. As Irmãs realizam sua missão nos continentes: americano, europeu e africano, presentes na Albânia, Benin, Brasil, Canadá, Inglaterra, Itália, México e Suíça. About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in São Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and co founded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Operations (TA Ops) team enables Nubank’s Talent Acquisition function to scale with consistency, speed, and quality. We operate and evolve the core systems and processes that support hiring while designing solutions that support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout their journeys. With a strong focus on automation, data quality, and user experience, we work to reduce manual effort and enhance decision-making across the board.

In this role, you’ll also be embedded in Nubank’s Business Automation hub – a central team focused on helping functions across the company become more efficient and scalable. There, you’ll collaborate with technical peers to align on architecture, implementation, and standards, ensuring consistency in what we deliver and supporting your ongoing technical development.

You will be responsible for
  • Process Analysis and Optimization: Collaborate closely with stakeholders within Talent Acquisition to thoroughly analyze existing business processes. Identify and prioritize opportunities for automation, focusing on areas that can benefit from increased efficiency, accuracy, and cost reduction.
  • Automation Development and Implementation: Leverage your expertise in UiPath and AI technologies to design, develop, and implement robust and scalable automation solutions. This includes building workflows, configuring bots, and integrating AI capabilities like machine learning and natural language processing to handle complex tasks.
  • Systems Integration: Work with multiple Talent Acquisition systems and tools, including Greenhouse (ATS), GEM (CRM), GoodTime (interview scheduling), custom-built solutions, and broader HR platforms. Design and maintain seamless data flows between systems, ensuring integration supports efficient processes while upholding data integrity and security across all automation workflows.
  • Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Act as a mentor and guide to less experienced team members. Share your knowledge and expertise, provide guidance on best practices, and foster a collaborative learning environment within the team.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Actively participate in multidisciplinary teams, working closely with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to deliver comprehensive automation solutions that align with business goals and objectives.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of developed solutions. This includes creating flow diagrams, technical manuals, user guides, and other relevant documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ease of maintenance.
  • Innovation and Technology Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in automation. Proactively identify and evaluate new tools, techniques, and methodologies that can be leveraged to enhance existing automation or develop innovative solutions.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. The specialist optimizes resources, manages budgets, participates in key projects, and collaborates with stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial globally.

  • Content Creation: Proficiency in content creation, including the development of content pillars and copywriting, with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage and inspire audiences.

  • Brand Governance: Implement the Global Brand Governance accurately across all markets, ensuring alignment with parent brands and involving key stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
Career Opportunities: Internal Auditor (17611)

World leader on its markets, Vallourec provides benchmark tubular solutions for the energy sector and other highly demanding applications: from oil and gas wells in extreme conditions to state-of-the-art power plants, including bold architectural projects and high-performance mechanical equipment.

In figures, Vallourec is a French industrial group listed on the SBF120 with 16,000 employees and a turnover of 5 billion euros. With a presence in 20 countries, the group operates on all continents.

Vallourec also encompasses 40 production units, 380 researchers and technicians, 4 research and testing centers, and over 45 million euros invested in R&D.

Finally, drawing on its experience in the Oil & Gas sector, Vallourec is preparing for the future by currently developing a comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions that meet the needs of energy transition: carbon capture, hydrogen storage, geothermal energy.

This context makes the environment particularly dynamic and international.

Main missions and activities:

  • Assess the application of procedures and processes by entities, corporate departments and Shared Services Centers throughout the Group.
  • Carry out audit missions (periodic audits or investigation).
  • Prepare recommendations for findings in a report dispatched to the Group managers.

Reporting to the Internal Audit Director, the internal auditor is in charge of:

Periodic audits

  • Preparing and carrying out periodic audits in line with Group methodology.
  • Leading the preparatory phase of the audit to ensure maximum efficiency and to obtain a global understanding of the organization's entity, key events and main areas of risks.

This involves:

  • Preparing audit notifications schedules and agendas.
  • Overseeing the operational phase of the audit: acting as the entity's point of contact.
  • Coordinating data collection (financial data, business review, risk analysis, audit reports,...).
  • Conducting interviews with key managers and all persons involved.
  • Defining audit scope and objectives.
  • Carrying out and supervising tests based on work standards and procedures.
  • Finalizing audit findings and prioritizing recommendations.
  • Monitoring the progress of action plans resulting from the audits carried out, with reference to the timetable established with the entities.
  • Promoting the sharing of best practices between Group entities.
  • Sending a report to the internal control director after the final meeting (report which will then be sent to the entity and to the Vallourec senior managers).

Investigations

The internal auditor could participate in fraud detection and resolution:

  • Prepare and carry out investigations if needed with the internal control director.
  • Propose a relevant methodology and work plan to address specific risks.
  • Coordinate with external support (if any).
  • Write ad hoc reports with recommendations (action plans).

In support of the Director of Internal Audit, the senior internal auditor will also be involved in:

  • Building the annual audit plan.
  • Improving audit methodology (review of work program and best practices).

Notes:

  • Many travels abroad, including long distances needed (USA, Brazil, China, Dubaï...).
  • Corporate position with diversified contacts throughout the Group, worldwide, at all levels (with senior management as well as in mills or with shared service centers).
  • Demonstrate ability to communicate and coordinate with all VLR departments involved. Particularly, ability to write reports mentioning recommendations and being objective.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • Previous experience of internal audit.
  • International experiences (at least as a long term trainee or as a student).

Skills: Autonomy, rigor, dynamic and “agile” mindset, communication skills.

A Olist é o sistema operacional do varejo e a parceira número 1 do empreendedor brasileiro.

Somos obcecados pelos nossos clientes, e essa paixão nos faz buscar entender continuamente suas dores para transformá-las em soluções que fortaleçam seus negócios e impulsionem suas vidas. Assim, entregamos um ecossistema para gestão do negócio, finanças, integrações, logística, inteligência competitiva de vendas e operações multicanal.

Tudo isso faz de nós um time de alta performance, com profissionais com senso de dono, com muita responsabilidade e proatividade para fazer acontecer.

COMO VOCÊ VAI APOIAR ESSA PARCERIA COM NOSSOS CLIENTES

Seu papel como HR Business Partner na Olist será impulsionar o desempenho das áreas, fortalecendo a liderança, atuando de forma estratégica e orientada por dados.

Esta é uma vaga presencial, em regime CLT e a logística de trabalho é perfeita para quem mora em Curitiba e região.

Suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Influenciar e atuar como parceiro de negócios, contribuindo para um clima favorável ao atingimento dos resultados esperados da área / unidade de negócios que atende;
  • Contribuir para capacitar a liderança em sua responsabilidade na gestão de pessoas dentro de suas equipes, por meio de coaching e/ou orientação em decisões que impactem a experiência do colaborador;
  • Apoiar o desenho organizacional das áreas atendidas de forma consultiva, identificando oportunidades de sinergia, movimentações, novas contratações e ações que garantam o desenvolvimento e a sucessão;
  • Facilitar e acompanhar o fluxo de informações para que a tradução e desdobramento da estratégia aconteça em todas as camadas;
  • Atuar ativamente na construção e manutenção de uma cultura de alta performance, embasada pelos valores e princípios da organização;
  • Mediar situações adversas de crise e conflitos dentro da sua esfera de influência;
  • Atuar de maneira orientada por dados, apoiando em tomadas de decisões baseadas nos principais KPIs de pessoas: Turnover, eNPS e pesquisas de pulso, People Review, Compensation, etc.
  • Fomentar iniciativas de desenvolvimento em conjunto com a área de Talent Management;
  • Contribuir na construção e implementação das ações da agenda institucional de pessoas, como programas de cultura, programas de desenvolvimento, ciclos de avaliação de desempenho, promoção e mérito, e adotando uma postura proativa e analítica em cada ação.
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado e trazer inovações para a equipe de Pessoas.
  • Apoiar diretamente no onboarding de lideranças, garantindo um processo fluído de adaptação à cultura e modelo de gestão.

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência como BP em áreas / unidades de negócio corporativas e voltadas à geração de resultado;
  • Experiência prévia em outros subsistemas de RH;
  • Vivência em problemas complexos relacionados à gestão de pessoas, gestão de mudanças e/ou cultura organizacional;
  • Entendimento e curiosidade em temas de negócio e estratégia;
  • Formação Superior completa;
  • Inglês nível conversação.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.

COMO SERÁ O PROCESSO?

Assim como na rotina do empreendedor brasileiro, no processo seletivo da Olist você também precisa passar por algumas etapas para alcançar o tão sonhado SIM. Você vai poder transformar a maneira de fazer comércio junto com a gente ao passar pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Inscrição;

  • Entrevista com pares do time;
  • Entrevista final com a liderança.

E pra que você possa se organizar, o nosso processo seletivo é remoto. Caso seja necessário alguma conversa presencial, vamos avisar com antecedência.

BENEFÍCIOS FLEXÍVEIS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER

Já imaginou decidir o quanto do seu benefício você vai gastar em alimentação, gasolina, farmácia e muitas outras categorias? Aqui, na Olist, isso é totalmente possível. title: Carbon Markets Policy Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Carbon Markets Policy Specialist to join our Carbon Markets Policy & Guidance team. The team tracks organizations and governments seeking to shape private sector responses to climate change and the development of the carbon credit market on the path to net zero. This vacancy is for an experienced researcher to join our team and take the lead on carbon market policy research in Latin America.

About the role:

This role will take a leading role on the continued development of MSCI Carbon Markets policy analysis, with a particular focus on the Latin America region. The Carbon Markets Policy Specialist will also be involved in collating qualitative and quantitative data to track organizations, investors and governments seeking to shape corporate responses to climate change and the use of carbon credits.

Key to success in this role will be the ability to generate concise insights from disparate sources of information, covering emerging or fast-moving policy areas and complex standards, reports, and regulations.

The role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities will include:

  1. Analysis of national and subnational climate and carbon market policy in a range of countries, including conducting interviews and preparing country profiles.
  2. Tracking developments in international policy and standards relating to climate change, net zero and the voluntary carbon market.
  3. Qualitative and quantitative research across the policy areas covered by the team.
  4. Thought leadership on carbon markets and climate policy, with a focus on Latin America.
  5. Supporting MSCI’s COP30 strategy and policy engagement in the region.
  6. Communicating insights internally and externally, delivered to clients through client meetings and conferences, plus monthly reporting, an online platform, webinars and other research projects.

Successful candidates will have research, advisory or public policy experience relating to climate policy, carbon markets, or corporate climate strategies. This may have been gained through experience with research firms, governments, consultancy, corporate or investor sustainability teams, project developers, think tanks, NGOs, or academia.

Candidates should have a strong team ethic, excellent written communications skills, and be capable of extracting insights and communicating them with clarity to senior-level audiences.

Qualifications and experience:

  1. Degree in Environmental Studies, Climate Change, Public Policy, or a related field. Post-graduate degree preferred.
  2. At least 5 years’ experience from the public, private, financial or NGO sectors relating to climate change, net zero, or carbon markets.
  3. Experience with national climate policy or international climate negotiations is particularly welcomed.
  4. Excellent communication skills in English and Portuguese. Communication skills in Spanish would be a distinct asset for this role.
  5. Proven responsibility for delivering reports, briefings, or other written outputs.
  6. Presentation skills to clearly articulate ideas and facilitate strong relations with a global team of carbon and climate research analysts, technology and operations teams.
  7. Knowledge across various climate policy issues, with the ability to extract insights and communicate complex issues to senior-level audiences.
  8. Demonstrable enthusiasm for addressing climate change in the corporate and financial sectors.

This role is for you if you are:

  1. Aware of what a corresponding adjustment is and actively interested in Article 6 debates.
  2. Inquisitive, analytical, and naturally inclined to ask, ‘But what does this mean?’, ‘So what?’ and ‘What happens next?’
  3. Comfortable both writing a 20-page report and summarizing a new policy development in a sentence.
  4. Collaborate generously with your teammates but effective at working independently.
  5. Are passionate and pragmatic about how the world can tackle the climate challenge.

What we offer you:

  1. Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
  2. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
  3. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
  4. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
  5. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our platform, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
  6. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
  7. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our purpose – to power better investment decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, we power better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.

  7. Wireframing e Prototipagem: Produzir wireframes, protótipos e mockups para novos recursos do site e do aplicativo.
  8. Design da Interface de Aplicativos: Projetar e atualizar a interface do aplicativo móvel, garantindo uma experiência consistente e amigável ao usuário em ambas as plataformas.

  1. Experiência comprovada como Designer UX/UI, especialmente com plataformas de e-commerce.

  1. Habilidades avançadas no Figma para wireframing e prototipagem.

  4. Experiência no uso do Jira para gerenciar tarefas de design e colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento.
  5. Compreensão sólida dos princípios de desenvolvimento front-end (conhecimento de HTML, CSS é um diferencial).
  6. Expertise em design responsivo e desenvolvimento mobile-first.
  7. Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa de usuários, testes de usabilidade e testes A/B.
  8. Forte atenção aos detalhes e paixão por criar experiências amigáveis ao usuário.
  9. Capacidade de colaborar de forma eficaz com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores e profissionais de marketing.
  10. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação para explicar claramente as decisões de design.
  11. Habilidades criativas de resolução de problemas para entregar soluções de design inovadoras e eficazes.

title: Comprador direto e indireto
description:
O Comprador indireto será responsável por obter, negociar e comprar bens e serviços indiretos, incluindo material de escritório, equipamento de TI, serviços de manutenção e itens de instalações, uniformes, EPIs (equipamentos de proteção individual), ferramentas e outros itens consumíveis.
Essa função envolve trabalhar em estreita colaboração com vários departamentos para entender suas necessidades, gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e orçamentos da empresa, além de garantir que o material/serviço seja entregue com base no pedido de compra, dando suporte a todos os departamentos.


PRINCIPAIS DEVERES

  1. Integrar o fornecedor, solicitar detalhes do fornecedor para configuração e enviá-los por meio do processo interno.
  2. Identificar e avaliar fornecedores para bens e serviços indiretos. Negociar contratos e preços para obter um bom valor para a organização.
  3. Solicitar cotação aos fornecedores, analisar os preços e termos de pagamento, garantindo o alinhamento com as condições pré-estabelecidas e validar ou enviar para um novo processo de aprovação com evidências apropriadas.
  4. Revisar as requisições com clareza e precisão, obter a cotação e prosseguir com as requisições para o pedido de compra indireto.
  5. Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho de aprovação do pedido de compra e garantir que todas as partes apropriadas envolvidas o aprovem antes de enviar o pedido de compra ao fornecedor.
  6. Enviar o pedido de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base nas requisições internas.
  7. Monitorar POs vencidos ou parcialmente recebidos para garantir que todos os itens sejam recebidos antes do pagamento.
  8. Gerenciamento de fornecedores, construir e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores para garantir entrega, serviço e conformidade com os acordos contratuais.
  9. Recebimento e validação de faturas com pedido de compra para encaminhá-lo à equipe de estoque e/ou equipe de logística.
  10. Liderar negociações com fornecedores sobre questões relacionadas a discrepâncias em quantidades, preços e outras condições.
  11. Manter o banco de dados organizado, atualizar a documentação e alcançar.
  12. Colaboração multifuncional, trabalhando com as partes interessadas internas para entender suas necessidades de aquisição e fornecer soluções oportunas.
  13. Fornecer atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas para garantir assistência adequada na aquisição e entrega de bens e serviços necessários.
  14. Pesquisa de mercado, manter-se informado sobre tendências de mercado e estratégias de preços para tomar decisões de compra informadas.
  15. Gestão de orçamento, monitorar e gerenciar gastos contra restrições orçamentárias, garantindo eficácia nas decisões de compra.
  16. Identificar oportunidades de eficiência de processos e implementar as melhores práticas em aquisição.
  17. Monitoramento de KPI.
  18. Dar suporte a auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências, documentação e informações solicitadas, bem como fornecer quaisquer explicações necessárias.
  19. Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento, fornecendo suporte técnico aos pares.

Escopo direto

  1. Enviar a ordem de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base na demanda para evitar escassez e excesso.
  2. Gerenciar o processo da cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo a colocação do pedido, rastreamento e acompanhamento até o recebimento do material do depósito.
  3. Comunicar-se com o fornecedor sobre entrega antecipada, problemas de estoque e itens alternativos aprovados quando necessário.
  4. Sourcing e aquisição, identificar, avaliar e selecionar fornecedores para materiais diretos, garantindo o alinhamento com as necessidades de produção e os padrões da empresa.
  5. Gestão de relacionamento com fornecedores, desenvolver e manter relacionamentos fortes com fornecedores para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho.
  6. Gestão de estoque, monitorar os níveis de estoque de materiais diretos, prever necessidades para evitar escassez ou situações de excesso de estoque.
  7. A colaboração multifuncional trabalha em estreita colaboração com as equipes de logística, produção, engenharia e garantia de qualidade para entender os requisitos e especificações de materiais.
  8. Garantia de qualidade, garantir que todos os materiais adquiridos atendam aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos de conformidade.
  9. Análise de mercado, manter-se informado sobre tendências de mercado, preços e dinâmica da cadeia de suprimentos.
  10. Manter registros precisos de compras, prazo de entrega, MOQ, preços e informações do fornecedor.
  11. Monitore os principais indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar a eficácia.

Mínimo de requisitos

Mínimo de 5 anos especificamente na indústria como uma posição de comprador.
Experiência anterior em compras ou gerenciamento da cadeia de suprimentos, de preferência com foco em compras indiretas.
Fortes habilidades de negociação e comunicação.
Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente entre departamentos.
Fortes habilidades organizacionais e multitarefas.
Conhecimento de tendências de mercado e estratégias de sourcing.
Experiência comprovada em compras diretas ou aquisições em um ambiente de fabricação ou produção.
Fortes habilidades analíticas e atenção aos detalhes.
Familiaridade com gestão de contratos e regulamentações de conformidade.
Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e cumprir prazos.
Conhecimento do processo de logística envolvendo compras (just-in-time, lead time de fornecimento).
Desenvolvimento e qualificações de fornecedores.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Senior Analyst – Energy Solutions
About Us:
For the past 12 years,CELA – Clean Energy Latin Americahas been providing financial and strategic advisory services to companies and investors in the renewable energy and energy transition sectors across Latin America.
We are specialists in consultancy (strategic, market, and regulatory), capital raising, project finance, and M&A, in segments such as solar and wind energy, energy storage, and green hydrogen.
For more information, visit:
Position: Senior Analyst – Energy Solutions
Profile:
We are seeking a Senior Analyst/Consultant to work on energy transition projects at CELA.
The candidate must be fluent in English and have prior experience in the power sector, with a background in areas such as self-production, regulation, or market intelligence.
We are looking for a proactive professional, eager to develop in various topics within the energy sector and capable of working independently.
We value professionals who are committed to the energy transition, skilled at building strategic relationships, and who contribute to the success of our dynamic consulting team.
Requirements:
· Minimum of 5 years of experience in the energy sector;
· Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields;
· Proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools;
· Advanced English – capable of leading meetings entirely in English, reading and writing technical materials with ease;
Key Responsibilities:
· Demonstrate technical and regulatory knowledge in self-production, generation, energy trading (with a focus on large consumers), and distributed generation, as well as produce descriptive and analytical reports;
· Assist clients in evaluating their consumption profiles and defining the most suitable energy procurement strategies;
· Support consumers and generators in structuring and negotiating power purchase agreements (PPAs) in the free market, including models such as self-production by equivalence, leasing, consortium, among others;
· Develop studies, reports, and dashboards on energy strategies and contract performance, providing insights for consumers and generators;
· Stay updated on renewable energy market trends, new business models, and regulatory changes;
· Provide support to other areas at CELA with expertise in regulation, energy products, auctions and trading.
Contract:
· Independent contractor ("PJ"), with exclusive dedication to CELA.
Benefits:
· Competitive compensation, negotiable based on the candidate's experience;
· Health and dental plan;
· Paid vacation.
Work Model:
· Primarily remote, with occasional in-person meetings required in São Paulo or other locations.
How to Aplly:
· Please send your CV to Luísa at ****** with the subject line:
"CV – Senior Analyst in Energy Solutions – CELA."

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

SSE is a multinational company with Italian roots and over 40 years of history, beginning operations in 1984 in the Prato region.

In 2009, we established our presence in Brazil, in the city of Santos, and have since become a trusted provider of engineering solutions and services focused on turbomachinery for the oil and gas sector.

Our services span across mechanical, control and automation, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines, through which we’ve successfully completed thousands of engineering and installation projects worldwide.

Our core business is delivering turnkey engineering solutions , offering tailored services and consulting with a single point of responsibility. We strive to reduce total operating and maintenance costs while enhancing the availability, efficiency, and operational reach of installed turbomachinery fleets, regardless of the original equipment manufacturer.

With this purpose in mind, we install and commission integrated solutions for rotating equipment, auxiliary systems, and process plants—executing both greenfield projects and brownfield upgrades to optimize and modernize mature production assets.

We also provide training, maintenance, after-sales support, remote monitoring, and other value-added services, leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare commercial, technical, and budgetary proposals, considering pricing, feasibility, risk, and cost structure.
  • Monitor and ensure deadlines are met throughout the proposal cycle, from initiation to delivery to the client.
  • Create and manage documentation and reports related to proposals, including technical, commercial, and financial information.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, production, and logistics teams to gather cost estimates, lead times, and required resources.
  • Consolidate cost estimates and define pricing strategies based on established margins and business goals.
  • Participate in internal meetings and occasionally client meetings to align proposal scope and conditions.
  • Support the sales team during contract negotiations when needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in technical and/or commercial proposals, preferably in control and automation or oil & gas engineering companies.
  • Strong knowledge of cost analysis, pricing, and bid documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with platforms such as Petronect, Ariba, or similar tools.

Soft Skills

  • Organization and attention to detail – Essential for managing technical documents, bids, and tight deadlines with accuracy and quality.
  • Analytical thinking – Ability to interpret technical and commercial requirements, assess proposal feasibility, and identify potential risks.
  • Proactivity – Anticipates needs, seeks information from involved departments, and acts independently to ensure timely delivery.
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) – Clarity in drafting proposals, interacting with technical and commercial teams, and presenting information objectively.
  • Teamwork – Works collaboratively with engineering, procurement, finance, and sales in a respectful and integrated manner.
  • Time and priority management – Handles multiple demands simultaneously while meeting schedules and delivery timelines.
  • Resilience and adaptability – Adjusts quickly to changes in scope, deadlines, or client requirements.
  • Results-oriented mindset – Committed to delivering high-quality, competitive, and accurate proposals.

A Ad Clinic é uma referência em estética e bem-estar, dedicada a oferecer tratamentos inovadores e personalizados que visam transformar a autoestima de nossos clientes. Com uma abordagem focada na qualidade, segurança e resultados efetivos, nossa clínica combina tecnologia de ponta com um time altamente capacitado de profissionais.

Estamos sempre à frente das tendências do mercado estético, buscando continuamente inovações que garantam a satisfação de nossos clientes. Acreditamos no potencial de cada colaborador e investimos em treinamento e desenvolvimento, criando um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inspirador.

Nosso compromisso é proporcionar não apenas experiências transformadoras para nossos clientes, mas também oportunidades de crescimento profissional para nossa equipe.   4. Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, além de excelentes habilidades de comunicação.

  6. Habilidade em Harmonização Facial com cursos de preenchedores avançados.

title: Vendedor de Calçados - Pantanal Shopping
description:
Job description

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Se você tem talento para atendimento, entende de modelo, grade e conforto que cada calçado pode oferecer para os nossos pés, seu lugar é aqui! Você vai ajudar os nossos clientes a encontrarem o calçado perfeito, com toda a sua paixão pelo esporte e conhecimento das últimas tecnologias.


Main responsibilities

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Saber mostrar o que temos de melhor em calçados, de acordo com as necessidades e especificações de cada cliente, além de destacar as tecnologias disponíveis no mercado.
  • Dar aquele show de conhecimento para os nossos clientes, com muita energia e disposição.

Requirements and skills

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Pra jogar bonito, você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio completo.
  • Experiência com vendas e/ou atendimento.
  • Conhecimento em calçados é considerado um diferencial.

Additional information

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

Uber for Business is a fast-growing Uber B2B solution serving a wide range of industries. We tackle large problems to adapt and best serve the needs of our customers and communities. We are seeking a hands-on B2B marketing leader who thrives with autonomy and accountability, possesses a strong data-driven mindset, and can translate insights into actionable strategies. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator with outstanding leadership and project management skills, capable of navigating a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple stakeholders to drive strategic growth.

About The Role

As Marketing Lead for Brazil, you will own the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for Uber for Business's enterprise offerings. Your target audiences include C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies and SMBs, with the goal of driving brand awareness and demand generation across multiple channels such as OOH, radio, digital performance, CRM, and in-app messaging. Reporting to the Regional Head of Marketing Latam, you will lead all country B2B marketing initiatives, manage cross-functional teams, and collaborate globally to scale our business in high-growth markets.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Strategic Leadership & Accountability: Define and own marketing ROI and customer acquisition costs for Brazil, setting budgets, KPIs, and targets.
  • Develop plans: Create annual and quarterly strategies balancing brand building and performance marketing to meet revenue goals.
  • Integrated Campaigns: Launch national awareness campaigns (primarily digital) that generate measurable lift and consideration.
  • Creative Translation: Convert brand strategies into impactful creatives, overseeing visual and content approval for the region.
  • Performance Optimization: Lead cross-functional initiatives to centralize performance operations, continuously testing and refining media mixes, attribution models, and automation tools.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage teams in Brazil, Mexico, and the US, ensuring alignment across Product, Operations, Legal, PR, Media, and Customer Experience.
  • AI Adoption: Act as the internal AI ambassador, driving AI adoption, coaching peers, and identifying strategic opportunities.
  • Enterprise Field Marketing & CRM: Develop strategies for field marketing and partner with Sales, Finance, and Strategy to ensure smooth launches and long-term client relationships with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 companies.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team.

  • Experience launching integrated awareness campaigns.
  • Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills across multiple countries.
  • Analytical skills with experience in performance metrics, funnel optimization, and AI tools.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in Marketing, Business, or related; MBA preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in agency digital strategy or in-house performance teams.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Marketing Platform, Salesforce, Asana, and AI marketing platforms.

If you thrive on balancing big-brand creativity with data-driven rigor, excel at stakeholder management across markets, and are passionate about harnessing AI to redefine enterprise marketing in Latin America, join us!

title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware
description:
Job description

A Kryptus é uma empresa brasileira com atuação global, especializada em cibersegurança e proteção de dados sensíveis . Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos referência no desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas em criptografia, segurança embarcada e defesa cibernética para os setores governamental, militar, financeiro e corporativo .

Quer ajudar o país a reduzir sua dependência tecnológica externa e, assim, subir mais um degrau rumo à soberania nacional? Que tal experimentar novos desafios técnicos em projetos com as Forças Armadas e grandes empresas parceiras do setor aeronáutico e de defesa?

Para atender essas demandas, estamos buscando Desenvolvedores de Firmware experientes para se juntarem ao nosso time.

Os profissionais atuarão de forma 100% presencial em projetos estratégicos de defesa, desenvolvendo, testando e integrando sistemas para uso em aeronaves e radares.

Main responsibilities

  1. Atuar na definição de arquitetura de sistemas embarcados;
  2. Desenvolver firmware bare-metal para equipamentos de defesa e aviônicos;
  3. Desenvolver e executar testes funcionais e de integração dos sistemas;
  4. Realizar estudos, leitura de normas e revisão de literatura técnica para implementação de sistemas auxiliares;
  5. Realizar análise e depuração de falhas, correção e otimização de código;
  6. Prestar suporte à certificação dos equipamentos;
  7. Redigir documentação técnica em inglês (análises, relatórios, manuais, resultados de testes etc.);
  8. Manter o código-fonte e demais artefatos do projeto sob controle de versão;
  9. Executar revisões de código e contribuir com a qualidade do software produzido.

Requirements and skills

OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Graduação em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com microcontroladores das famílias MSP430 ou STM32;
  • Proficiência na linguagem C e em desenvolvimento de firmware bare-metal;
  • Ampla vivência na utilização de equipamentos de laboratório (analisador lógico, osciloscópio, multímetro, gerador de sinais etc.) e na exploração de documentação técnica (datasheets, manuais de referência, application notes etc.);
  • Inglês avançado para redação, leitura e comunicação oral;
  • Experiência com Git em linha de comando.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em técnicas e padrões de codificação segura (CERT C, MISRA etc.);
  • Experiência com linguagem Assembly;
  • Experiência com linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL, Verilog etc.) e com dispositivos de lógica programável (CPLD e FPGA);
  • Conhecimento em criptografia e implementação de algoritmos criptográficos em microcontroladores.

Additional information

A Kryptus oferece um pacote bem completo de benefícios:

  • Horário flexível
  • PLR

Além disso…

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development

  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices

  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management)
description:
Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management)

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) role at Canonical

Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management)

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management) to build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From Ubuntu One SSO to Juju, LXD and MAAS your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.
This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.
As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.
You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.
In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.
What we are looking for in you

  • Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team
  • Experience with Go and Python software development
  • Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system
  • Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance
  • Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems
  • Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Responsibilities

A Oportunidade

Seja a principal fonte de manutenção de dados e processos de vendas para as equipes locais de vendas (Gerente Divisional e Supervisores), coordenando, apoiando e monitorando iniciativas regionais de GTM e projetos regionais no Centro de Distribuição (DC). Liderando a equipe de Analistas de Campo GEDA em toda a Divisão.

Seu Impacto

  • Orientar a equipe de Vendas (Gerentes/Supervisores/Fornecedores) por meio de desempenho de KPIs, tendências e análises, desenvolvendo ScoreCards que ajudam a identificar oportunidades de serviço e execução.

  • Apoiar a agenda de POCs nos DCs, garantindo recursos, acompanhamento de KPIs e fornecendo insights operacionais.

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
Join to apply for the Tax Coordinator role at Unilever

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you love fast-paced environments, are passionate about helping others, and like the sounds of acting as an orchestrator where your impacts will be felt throughout multiple countries then this role is just for you!

Business Context: Direct Taxes are the taxes levied on profit, from here the employee will:

  • manage direct taxes in a collaborative environment;
  • interact with other areas of the group (finance, marketing, sales);
  • be introduced to company´s businesses;
  • work for and with the decision makers.

Main Purpose

Support the company on the management and reporting of direct taxes, ensuring compliance, optimizing cash flow, and being aware of the company´s profitability. These efforts contribute to the Group's Sustainable Living Plan Goal.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Calculate and report direct taxes (IRPJ and CSLL), including current, deferred, and contingent taxes, as well as taxes on cross-border transactions (royalties, cost sharing, dividends, interest, CIDE, IOF, etc);
  • Understand Gaap Differences such as Brazil Gaap, IFRS, USGAAP;
  • Perform Transfer Pricing calculations;
  • Obtain and maintain tax incentives (e.g., Lucro da Exploração, Inovação Tecnológica, Lei Rouanet);
  • Review and supervise calculations, payments, and tax returns;
  • Manage tax contingencies and exposures;
  • Analyze and interpret direct tax law;
  • Engage in direct tax planning (M&A, new business models, etc);
  • Forecast direct tax outcomes;
  • Calculate Effective Tax Rate (ETR);
  • Prepare and present tax reports locally and globally;
  • Partner with other areas for consultancy;
  • Participate in tax audits (internal and external);
  • Handle tax inspections by authorities.

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Experience in Corporate Income Taxes (IRPJ and CSLL) and remittances;
  • Proficiency in English (writing, reading, speaking);
  • Knowledge of Tax and Accounting principles.

Desirable Skills

  • Power BI;
  • Automation and tax transformation;
  • Data analysis skills.

Skills

  • Time management;
  • Decision making;
  • Growth mindset;
  • Collaboration and teamwork;
  • Positivity;
  • Creative thinking;
  • Conflict resolution;
  • Motivation;
  • Openness to innovation.

Leadership

  • Deliver results with enthusiasm;
  • Lead by example in results and resilience;
  • Seek continuous improvement and collaborate;
  • Own your wellbeing and work standards;
  • Be humble, data-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life. We are committed to equity, inclusion, and diversity to drive our results and create a better future. We want everyone to bring their ‘Whole Self’ to work. If you need support or accommodations, please inform us during your application process.
